guidance: One task per guide. Steps must be actionable and ordered. Pair each action with an expected outcome. Troubleshooting is optional—include only common, real issues. Prefer numbered lists for steps.

children.title: The Goal
children.guidance: What the user will achieve by following this guide.

children.title: Prerequisites
children.guidance: What they need to know, have, or configure first. Bullets preferred.

children.title: Step
children.guidance: Title each instance with the step action, not "Step".

children.title: Action
children.guidance: Specific click, command, or input required.

children.title: Expected Outcome
children.guidance: What the system should show or do in response.

outline.title: Troubleshooting
outline.guidance: Common issues. Wrapper is always present; omit instances when none.

children.title: Common Issue
children.guidance: Title each instance with the error or symptom, not "Common Issue".

children.title: The Problem
children.guidance: What the user sees or experiences.

children.title: The Solution
children.guidance: How to fix it and get back on track.
